from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class DefaultParent(BaseModel):
    before: int = Field(10, title='Before')
    value: int = Field(1, title='Value')
    after: int = Field(30, title='After')


class RequiredChild(DefaultParent):
    value: int = Field(..., title='Value')
